notes.title: Alice's Lullaby Set for an October 8, 2024, Launch
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nHSfNL70FDQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Ape  Law,  the  innovative  studio  behind  the cult classic Albino Lullaby, announces the October 8, 2024, release of Alice's Lullaby. This latest entry in the psychological horror genre invites players to traverse the eerie and treacherous world of Styx, where time is both ally and adversary. Prepare to tumble through time and unravel the horrific mysteries of the enigmatic Grandchild Cult. 
 
A Twisted Journey Through Time and Trauma 
 
Alice's  Lullaby  plunges  players  into  a  deeply  haunting  narrative  that  challenges  their grip on reality. The game centers on a perilous mission to rescue young Alice from the clutches  of  the  Grandchild  Cult,  a  group  driven  by  their  fanatical  zeal  to  construct  a device that can undo their past mistakes and unleash terror upon the world above. As the  only  "walkling"  with  the  vision  to  see  through  their  machinations,  players  must navigate  a  dark  world,  journeying  between  past  and  future  to  expose  the  mysteries hidden within Styx and thwart the cult’s grand ambitions. 
 
“We’ve crafted a narrative that not only terrifies but also delves deep into the psyche,” said  Justin  Pappas,  Creative  Director  and  Founder  of  Ape  Law.  “Alice's  Lullaby  uses horror conventions to explore themes of trauma and perception, inviting players to look closer and find the unsettling answers hidden beneath the surface.” 
 
Key Features of Alice's Lullaby: 
 
• Time-Tumbling Gameplay: Seamlessly travel between past and present, 
solving intricate puzzles and altering events to rescue Alice. 
• Striking Visual Contrast: Experience a world that is deceptively vibrant on the 
surface,  yet  dark  and  sinister  underneath,  capturing  the  duality  of  the  human 
psyche. 
• Narrative Depth: Unravel the metaphysical mystery of Styx and the Grandchild 
Cult, challenging players to discover why they are perceived as the monster. 
• Psychological Horror Elements: Encounter a game that reflects the distorted 
reality of trauma, where every corner of the environment tells a part of the story. 
• Rich World-Building: Explore the detailed, multi-layered world of Styx, where 
every discovery adds depth to the narrative. 
 
A New Chapter in Immersive Horror 
 
Alice's Lullaby signifies a daring leap forward in Ape Law's game design philosophy. By 
leveraging time manipulation and a narrative layered with psychological intrigue, the 
game promises a unique experience that will leave a lasting impact on players. This isn't 
just a continuation of a beloved franchise; it's an invitation to dive deeper into a world 
where horror and reality blur. 
 
Wishlist and Availability Information 
 
Alice's Lullaby is available to Wishlist now and set to release on October 8, 2024 for PC. 
Be among the first to unravel the metaphysical mystery of the grandchild cult and find 
out why they call you the monster! For more information, including access to exclusive 
content, screenshots, and trailer visit: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205190/Alices_Lullaby 
 
About Ape Law 
 
Ape  Law  is  an  independent  game  development  studio  dedicated  to  pushing  the 
boundaries of storytelling and design within the horror genre. Their debut title, Albino 
Lullaby,  earned  a  reputation  as  a  cult  classic,  celebrated  for  its  unique  approach  to 
psychological  horror  and  narrative  complexity.  Building  on  this  legacy,  Ape  Law 
continues  to  innovate  with  each  new  release.  Alice's  Lullaby,  the  highly  anticipated 
follow-up, promises to expand the universe and offer an even deeper, more immersive 
experience that challenges player perceptions and fears. 
Website:  http://www.ApeLaw.com  
 
 
### 
 
[Video] Announcement Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nHSfNL70FDQ 
Press Kit: http://aliceslullaby.com/presskit 
 
For Steam keys, exclusive content, or interview requests, please contact:  
Jack Dalrymple | CMO | Ape Law | 617-420-2281 | jack@albinolullaby.com

notes.title: Latest hotfix / Patchnotes and upcoming support
notes.content:
Hello,

on 24th of January I initially added a new build to the VR testing branch (which is open to anyone wanting to opt into early updates) that I moved to the mainline branch, the patch is regarded as a hotfix and is not a new iterated build so the build number stands as 2.0.0

The hotfix includes:

[b]A recompile that should fix the note pickup issue in VR (where the game would lose frames and flicker into the steam VR home area then back to the game).[/b]

[b]A fix to the rooftops area in which some players could not access the tower room for one of the buttons to unlock the matchbox (as reported on the forums and by other users).[/b]

[b]Removal of double vision causing 2D text for VR (This will later be replaced by 3D text renders for controls and objective information).[/b]

I want to thank everyone for being patient with this and posting these bugs so that I can properly investigate them, so please be sure to let us know if you're still having any issues!

[b]As a friendly reminder there is now a VR Bug Tracking sub discussion board please relay all VR inquiries to that section so they are easier to receive.[/b]

---

In tangent to sorting bugs out I can safely say I am working on the addition of possible motion control support (HTC Vive / Steam VR) to go along with more VR complementary additions (3D menu's / additional menu options for VR).

These will be rolled out into the vr testing branch first! not into the mainline as I will be building on the functionality incrementally instead of rolling it out as one big update. This way we can hopefully get feedback as we push things out.

An announcement will be made once that begins starting out basic then as I add more functionality.

Thank you all again and for the continued support as we push to keep improving Albino Lullaby and push into the future of the universe.

notes.title: Update to v 2.0.0
notes.content:
Our new engineer, Ethan's first task was to put together a build packed with bug fixes and get it up on steam asap. We have fixes for quite a few bugs, notorious and otherwise. 

-Fixed the issue with one of the notes not showing up the second half of th episode. You should have no trouble getting the 'all notes collected' achievement now. 

-Fixed lighting issues on doors. 

-Fixed ambient light gong out in rooftops.

-Fixed the darkness engulfing the entrance to Fairday's chamber

-Fixed issues with capture breaking once players land in The Basement. 

-Removed an errant mesh in the conclusion.

-Removed a buggy decal from the conclusion. 

-Fixed some issues with the player losing the clicker upon death. 

-Smoothed out the explosion leading into the long fall. 

-Rebuilt lighting

-Added some components that should improve stereo 3D

-Fixed broken blue light in the prison.

-Fixed collision issues on the rotating room. 

-Removed some errant meshes in the long fall

-Blocked some openings players were using to get out of the level.

-Various other small tweaks. 

Ethan's Vive arrives in the mail next week, and his next task is to get stereo 3D and positional tracking working correctly with the Vive (still works great on Oculus) So stay tuned! 

If you have any suggestions for things we should fix in our next build please send them to contact@apelaw.com

Thanks a ton for playing!

notes.title: Mega performance update!
notes.content:
To coincide with the DAWN of the VR era, we'd like to announce that we've updated Albino Lullaby with a megalithic performance overhaul!

The game now runs silky smooth at 90hz in VR on req spec machines and will resonate with even MORE joy in 2D. 

Both experiences are great so if you've already played in 2D I highly recommend a return in VR ! The Grandchildren are taller than you remember. 

Thanks so much to the community and all your feedback! You helped us find some of our most performance heavy spots. 

Keep the feedback coming, and always feel free to reach out to us at: Contact@ApeLaw.com

There are more exciting announcements coming from us in the coming months/weeks, so stay tuned!
You can add yourself to our mailing list at albinolullaby.com

Huzzah!

notes.title: Albino Lullaby's First Major Update !
notes.content:
Happy Halloween month to all y'all spooks! 
We've posted our first major update to Albino Lullaby. 

Here is a summarized list of our changes: 

-28 brand new achievements
-Trading Cards
-Badges
-Checkpoints closer together in challenging segments.
-Fixes for AI detection in rooftops.
-Improved AI pathing.
-Improved lighting visibility in many areas.
-Bonus track, 'Subjugated Siren' added to the original sound track.
-Indicated to the player that they can read collected notes from the
 main menu.
-Many many more bug fixes for bugs found by the community. 
 (Thanks community!)

I want to thank those that have really helped us champion the game. We are a very small team so feedback from you folks has been invaluable to us. We've watched just about every You Tube let's play of the game we could find and have really taken your thoughts into consideration. Not only have you helped us find incredibly elusive bugs, you helped us to make a smoother, more fun and rewarding game! Thanks so much for your honesty! Keep helping us spread the word about Albino Lullaby while we keep working to make the game even better!

Remember, you can always reach us at Contact@ApeLaw.com with suggestions, ideas, issues, and general warm feelings. 

HOOAH!
-Justin
